verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own cap-table page says it 'supports ASC 718 reporting', which is a first-party claim for this capability. That single marketing line is the only evidence: there are no docs on how the expense reports are generated, what they contain, or whether they are audit-ready. The cap table report downloads (eqvista-docs-12) are general cap table exports, not stock-compensation expense reports. Missing for 10: documentation of the ASC 718 expense report workflow and contents (expense amortization, fair-value/Black-Scholes inputs, forfeitures), auditor-ready export formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation that accountants and auditors accept the output.
